sampling.dtype: bf16 model logits, fp32 log-softmax and reductions
sampling.logit_stage: store pretransform logits identity separately; distances use normalized actual sampling distribution

arms.B2: E2 joint body + frozen head correct predecessor
arms.B3: same B2 fixed H/features; permute predecessor only within C/i alive branches
arms.B4: each raw body calibrated on dev with one global log-temperature

AB.terminal_anchor: exclude EOS anchor; missing second anchor not replaced
AB.n1: KL conditional empirical term zero tagged degenerate; A pairwise TV missing; B permutation identity retained
AB.eos: include EOS prediction state, no states after EOS, no replacement branches
AB.runtime_id: HF-SDPA-BF16-reference/E2/frozen; native parity not yet established

C.survival_estimator: mean G_k * product min(1, p(token_i)/q_actual(token_i)); full-vocab overlap reported separately
C.G: proposal-path EOS before k, proposed length, remaining request budget at round start only; no realized acceptance events
C.counting: separate accepted/emittable proposal, rejection correction, all-accepted bonus, EOS and clipped output
C.EOS_identity_evidence: data/native/pilot_c/B0/attempt_2/scheduler_emissions.jsonl; only ordinary anchor, no verifier observations

calibration.objective: TV with same C/position/branch/prompt equal-weight hierarchy
calibration.tie_break: smallest absolute log-temperature then smaller value
calibration.positions: all available positions 1..15; primary mechanism effect remains 2..15

statistics.aggregation: branch mean and permutation mean within C/i; position mean within C; C mean within prompt; prompt equal weights
statistics.pooled: equal domain weights then prompt weights within each domain
statistics.multiple_testing: single designated pooled primary plus required raw improvement; domain/strata exploratory intervals, no significance search
statistics.threshold_rule: after dev pilot before test, max(.005, 10*observed replay/numeric TV absolute error)
statistics.support: primary and raw improvement CI lower bounds exceed frozen threshold; i1 abs effect within numeric tolerance
statistics.weaken: upper bound below effect threshold or raw improvement upper bound <=0; otherwise inconclusive

must_pass_before_test: HF A/B dev probability and full-vocabulary metrics
HF A/B replay parity and anchor offsets
declared HF target-branch EOS censoring identity
freeze A/B code hashes and threshold
lock.formal_test_scope: A/B only; native C inconclusive at technical exit; no native test collection

exits.budget: save and stop verified own job before cumulative 24h; no expansion
